target_customer: Trust and safety teams at social platforms, marketplaces, AI labs and AI video companies that pay for moderation and abuse investigation tooling
problem: Trust and safety teams built internal tools or used generic CRMs to review abuse; Cinder sells a purpose built operations platform for content decisions and investigations.
business_model: enterprise SaaS platform plus services (red teaming, data labeling, managed moderation)
product_category: trust and safety operations and AI safety infrastructure

founders.name: Glen Wise
founders.background_notes: YC page: security engineer at Facebook building community threat intelligence, over three years; started Cinder in 2021.

founders.name: Phil Brennan
founders.background_notes: YC page: joined Facebook in 2017 to build community threat intelligence team.

founders.name: Brian Fishman
founders.background_notes: Named as cofounder in Radical Ventures coverage; not on YC page.

founders.name: Declan Cummings
founders.background_notes: Named as cofounder in Radical Ventures coverage; not on YC page.

competitors.name: Spectrum Labs
competitors.traction_then: Named as rival in launch coverage

competitors.name: ActiveFence
competitors.what: Trust and safety platform for detecting harmful content

technical_complexity.rationale: Case management, data integration and policy workflow software for large platforms, with later AI agent features; standard enterprise engineering with scale needs.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integration into customer moderation workflows and credibility from Meta and government threat intelligence backgrounds; though large platforms could build in house.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acquired or absorbed it through 2026; it raised a Series B in May 2026.

market_need_then: Platforms faced rising regulatory and public pressure on content moderation in 2021 and 2022 and often built internal tools; the founders saw the need at Facebook.

branding.domain_note: Uses cinder.ai on its site; Technical.ly links cinder.co; which is primary not confirmed.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and mission driven, short declarative headlines

brand_strength.rationale: Little coverage of the brand itself; enterprise buyers chose on product and founder credentials.

outcome_analysis: Cinder was founded by former Meta threat intelligence staff, launched from stealth in December 2022 with 14 million from Accel and Y Combinator, and extended into AI safety, adding customers such as Synthesia and Wizz. A 41 million Series B in May 2026 suggests growing enterprise demand driven by the AI abuse tailwind.
notes: Seed and Series A were announced together in December 2022; actual seed close date may be 2022-05 per an aggregator. Series B stated by company site headline and Radical blog; amount 41M. Competitor sources are dated 2022-12 or undated aggregator lists, after the batch start; rivals existed before. Cofounders Fishman and Cummings come from Radical blog only.
